nodes.description: Public state variable stakingContract of type StakingContract at fixed address 0x8D8A3e7EAdA138523c2dcB78FDbbF51A63A3faAD.
External view function balanceOf(address owner) returns (uint256 balance); returns the length of the depositsOf array from stakingContract.
Input parameter owner (address) used as the account passed to stakingContract.depositsOf.
Named return variable balance holding the length of the array returned by depositsOf(owner).
External call to stakingContract.depositsOf(owner) returning uint256[]; reads the array length as the return value.

edges.reason: owner parameter is passed as the account argument to the external depositsOf call, controlling which account's deposits are queried.
external call depositsOf is invoked on the stakingContract state variable.
balanceOf function contains and executes the external call to depositsOf.
array length from depositsOf result flows to the named return variable balance.

normalization_plan.reason: owner is a parameter of balanceOf; its value is consumed inside the function by the external call.
balance is the named return variable of balanceOf; it is not a separate storage or unsafe operation.
